description.content: Create an upload session that allows an app to iteratively upload ranges of a file, so as to attach the file to the specified Outlook item. The item can be a message or event. Request headers for each PUT operation let you specify the exact range of bytes to be uploaded. This allows transfer to be resumed, in case the network connection is dropped during upload.
